_comment: External MCP servers AVIA launches. The agents/shared McpRegistry consumes this file. Copy env values from .env.example; fields prefixed with ${ENV} are expanded at load time.

d365fo-nav._about: dynamics365ninja/d365fo-mcp-server — 54 tools for read/navigate over ~584k indexed X++ symbols, plus local AxTable/AxForm mutations. Used by both Architect (read) and Developer (read+write) in AVIA.

fo-semantic._about: xplusplusai/fo-semantic-mcp — semantic NL search over 166k+ F&O artifacts. Commercial, requires FOINDEX_API_KEY.

azure-devops._about: microsoft/azure-devops-mcp — official Microsoft MCP for Azure DevOps. Entra browser auth on first run.

erp._about: Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP MCP (dynamic, public preview). Requires F&O >=10.0.47 + feature enabled + agent platform allow-listed. Recommended model: claude-sonnet-4-6 (per Microsoft guidance for Sonnet 4.5 in the preview).
